# Clément Lemaine

> Clément Lemaine, hospitality management student at Vatel Madrid. Six months at Jumeirah Mallorca, fluent in French, English and Spanish.

Second-year hospitality management student with six months of hands-on experience in a 5-star luxury resort. Confident public speaker, team-oriented, reliable and quick to learn. Passionate about guest experience and AI.

## Experience

- 2022 · Internship — Loewe, Madrid. Discovering the luxury industry: observing and supporting sales, logistics and brand management.
